introHtml: SRCG carpenter pencils are built for the job site, with a flat shape that prevents rolling and a durable lead that marks on wood, metal, and drywall. When you order custom SRCG carpenter pencils in bulk, you can imprint your company logo or safety message directly on the barrel using pad printing or foil stamping. These are a practical giveaway for contractors, builders, and trade show attendees who need a reliable marking tool every day.
